svg.title: Eldmark: schematic world map for the level 60 cap (phase 6-8 plan)
svg.desc: Schematic map, not to scale. Each realm is a sector around Eldrun: the capital between zones 1-10 and 10-20 on the outer edge, then 20-32, 32-45 and the border 45-60 against the front wall with its two gates. In the center, Eldrun with Aldcor, three castles and six forts. D1 to D6 are instanced dungeons shared by the three realms, each with an entrance in every realm.
svg.text: Gates: Gate of the Penitents · Golden Gate
